Golf carts and NEVs are distinct under Texas law. Do not travel on Highway 361 south of Avenue G. Check the city crossing guide for designated crossings. The city annual plate is distinct from the Texas state golf-cart plate. This video does not promise every beach access or nighttime route is open.

Current state golf cart section: S.C. 56-2-90. Former 56-2-105 was repealed in 2025. Default daylight, secondary-road and four-mile limits apply absent a local ordinance; lights alone do not authorize night driving. Under-12 public-road passengers need fastened safety belts. Act 164 (2026) has golf-course and event exceptions, not used here as visitor permissions.

XfFqmap5Ohw.title: Where can you drive a golf cart on 30A? (Legal roads map)
XfFqmap5Ohw.description:
Where can you drive a golf cart or LSV on 30A / South Walton, FL?

Plain golf carts are not allowed on public roads in Walton County. Street-legal low-speed vehicles (LSVs) may use roads posted 35 mph or less, but not US Highway 98, and not sidewalks or bike paths. Crossing 98 is only at a four-way intersection.

Free interactive map (green = LSV-legal, red = avoid):
https://golfcartmap.com/30a

iPhone app (free):
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/golf-cart-ma...

Walton County Sheriff LSV rules:
https://waltonso.org/lsv/

Florida LSV statute (F.S. 316.2122):
http://www.leg.state.fl.us/statutes/index....

This is a planning map, not legal advice. Always follow posted signs. Rules checked November 2026.
